description: Get House of Representatives roll call vote results with member-level party breakdown. Primary source: Congress.gov API (118th Congress onward); falls back to clerk.house.gov XML for older congresses. Coverage: 1990 to present. Use year param for historical votes. Cross-reference with: congress_senate_votes (same bill's Senate vote), FEC (members' donors via fec_candidate_financials), lobbying_search (who lobbied on the bill), FRED (economic impact 1-3 years after passage). For Senate votes, use congress_senate_votes.

congress.description: Congress number (default: current). Used with session to determine year.

vote_number.description: Specific roll call vote number. Omit to list recent votes.

year.description: Calendar year (e.g. 2024). Overrides congress+session if provided.

name: congress_house_votes
